ext.description: Your Claude companion in VS Code: live usage and rate-limit monitoring for Claude Code (session, weekly, Opus, Sonnet) in the sidebar and status bar, with threshold alerts and paid-credit tracking. Includes Claude Vault, an encrypted local store that lets Claude use your API keys and secrets without ever seeing them, in shell commands and MCP tools.
cap.untrusted: The extension only reads the local OAuth token and never runs workspace code.
cfg.pollSeconds: Seconds between API calls. A cache shared across every VS Code window means one real request feeds them all.
cfg.alerts: Notify when the 5-hour session reaches 80% then 95%, and the weekly limit 90%.
cfg.statusBar: Show usage in the status bar.
cfg.pauseWhenExhausted: When a limit is exhausted, suspend API calls until the reset time Anthropic reports, instead of polling for nothing. The refresh button overrides the pause.
cfg.showCredits: Show paid credits spent beyond the plan, when extra usage is enabled on the Claude account.
cmd.vault.autoApprove: Let Claude replace keys without asking
cfg.badge: Show a badge with the session percentage on the activity-bar icon.
cfg.statusBarPosition: Which side of the status bar shows the usage figure.
cfg.statusBarStyle: How the status-bar figure looks: classic, Claude colour, or a prominent coloured pill.
cfg.statusBarWeek: Also show the weekly limit in the status bar, after the session.
cmd.moveToSecondary: Move to the secondary side bar
cmd.moveToPrimary: Move back to the left side bar
cfg.location: Where the panel lives: the activity bar on the left, or the secondary side bar on the right, next to the chat. The mirror button in the panel's title bar toggles this too.
